newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Samaraenergo pre-tax profit falls in '96.
newsitem.headline: Samaraenergo pre-tax profit falls in '96.

text.p: NOTES -- The results are not prepared to international accounting standards but to Russian accounting standards on a cash basis, which differ significantly from those normally supplied in the West. Russian accounts are designed to meet the requirements of the tax authorities. Definitions of profit and assets differ significantly from those in the West, and converting Russian accounts to international standards can turn a profit into a loss.
Figures are not adjusted for inflation or the depreciation of the rouble, but the following data may be helpful.
